office_hours: Offices are open Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. Staff may start between 07:30 and 09:30.
annual_leave: Full-time staff receive 22 days of annual leave per year. Requests must be made at least 10 working days in advance.
remote_working: Staff may work remotely up to two days per week with their manager's approval.
expense_claims: Claims must be submitted within 30 days with receipts. Claims above $500 need director approval.
password_reset: Passwords can be reset through the self-service portal. Accounts lock after five failed sign-in attempts.
it_support: The IT help desk is available 08:00 to 18:00 on working days.
